subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Feishu-local source-message recall cancellation path before defining the shared cross-channel edit/delete/recall lifecycle contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55691?
rationale: The implementation stays inside the Feishu plugin, but it changes run/session cancellation and reply-delivery semantics for behavior the canonical issue still frames as a cross-channel product/API decision.

options.title: Accept Feishu slice after proof
options.body: Land this bounded plugin-local path once the docs/setup subscription gap is fixed and live Feishu/Lark proof covers pending, active, and reply-suppression behavior.

options.title: Require shared lifecycle first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a source-message edit/delete/recall contract and then adapt Feishu to that shared contract.

options.title: Keep as draft candidate
options.body: Leave the PR open as an implementation sketch but require proof and a narrower architecture decision before treating it as merge-ready.

recommendation.title: Accept Feishu slice after proof
recommendation.body: Land this bounded plugin-local path once the docs/setup subscription gap is fixed and live Feishu/Lark proof covers pending, active, and reply-suppression behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The key unresolved choice is the plugin-local versus shared channel lifecycle boundary, where this person has the clearest recent runtime-context and channel architecture history.
